vignette — GFX2D post op

• Data kinds: rgb → rgb

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vignette(rgb, strength=0.6, radius=1.0, power=2.0) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import gfx2d; gfx2d.vignette(rgb, strength=0.6, radius=1.0, power=2.0), registry से लेना हो तो opsgfx2d.get("vignette"))

उपयोग

कोनों की ओर गहरा करता है: out = rgb * (1 - strength * t**power)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

t is the distance from the geometric centre ((h-1)/2, (w-1)/2) divided by radius times the half-diagonal, clipped at 1. The factor at t = 0 is exactly 1, so strength=0 is the exact identity and — for an odd-sized image, where a pixel actually sits on the centre — that pixel is returned untouched. An even-sized image has no centre pixel: its four innermost pixels are 0.707 px out and are already attenuated, which is geometry rather than a rounding error.
